name: fairpr
description: Fair PR checks for the AI era: stop AI-slop pull requests without punishing honest contributors.

scripts.build: npm run build:action && npm run build:cli && npm run build:bench
scripts.build:action: tsc --noEmit && ncc build src/main.ts -o dist --license licenses.txt
scripts.e2e: node test/e2e/mock-github.mjs && node test/e2e/cli.mjs && node test/e2e/bench.mjs
scripts.build:bench: ncc build src/bench/bin.ts -o bench --license licenses.txt && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('bench/index.js','bench/fairpr-bench.js')"
